empty.subtitle: Create a new tab to get started

toolbar.cookiesAutoTip: Auto-saving response cookies to the jar after every request (all tabs, remembered across sessions).
toolbar.cookiesManualTip: Response cookies are saved manually. Click to auto-save them to the jar instead.

toolbar.corsActiveTip: CORS active - click to bypass CORS via backend proxy

urlBar.expandHint: Enter or Esc to close · ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send

body.noBody: This request does not have a body
body.insertEnvelopeTitle: Replace the body with a SOAP envelope skeleton
body.soapFootnote: 1.1 → <mono>text/xml</mono> + <mono>SOAPAction</mono> header · 1.2 → <mono>application/soap+xml</mono> (action in Content-Type). Set automatically on send unless you override it in Headers.
body.binaryUnsupported: Binary file upload is not yet supported in the browser client

form.clearFileTitle: Clear file (keep the field, drop the attachment)

auth.noAuthBody: This request does not use any authorization.
auth.bearerHint: The token will be sent as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
auth.basicHint: Credentials will be Base64 encoded and sent as: Authorization: Basic <encoded>
auth.apiKeyHint: The API key will be sent as a custom header or query parameter with the name and value you specify.
auth.oauth2Hint: OAuth 2.0 authorizes access using an access token obtained from an authorization server. Select a grant type and fill in the required fields for your provider.
auth.statePlaceholder: Random state value for CSRF protection
auth.digestHint: Digest authentication uses a challenge-response mechanism. The server provides a nonce, and the client hashes the credentials with it to avoid sending passwords in plain text.
auth.awsHint: AWS Signature V4 signs requests using your AWS credentials. This is required for authenticating with AWS services like S3, Lambda, or API Gateway.
auth.hawkHint: Hawk is an HTTP authentication scheme providing partial cryptographic verification of requests. It is used as an alternative to Bearer tokens when you need message integrity.
auth.ntlmHint: NTLM (NT LAN Manager) is a Microsoft authentication protocol commonly used in Windows environments and with IIS servers. Provide your Windows domain credentials.

msg.noAccessTokenFragment: No access token found in redirect URL fragment.
msg.gotCodeNeedTokenUrl: Got code but Token URL is required to exchange it.

scripts.extractTitleReady: Extract a response field to an env variable
scripts.extractTitleSendFirst: Send a request first to extract fields

tests.description: Write JavaScript tests to validate the response. Use pm.test() and pm.expect() for assertions.

preRequest.description: Write JavaScript to execute before the request is sent. Use pm object to set variables and headers.

guide.title: Script Reference
guide.description: APIs for pre-request and test scripts. Both run the same sandbox; pre-request runs before the request is sent, tests run after the response arrives.

preRequest.whatRunsDesc: A pre-request script runs server-side right before the request is sent. Use it to mutate headers, generate dynamic values (timestamps, signatures, nonces), or persist env variables for the run.
preRequest.pmRequestDesc: Read and mutate the outgoing request. Changes flow into the actual HTTP call.
preRequest.pmEnvironmentDesc: Read or write active environment variables. Sets from a pre-request survive for the whole run and are persisted back to the environment.
preRequest.consoleDesc: Everything you log here shows up in the Console tab of the response panel.
preRequest.hmacDesc: Generate a signed header from the body before sending.
preRequest.refreshDesc: Fetch a token once and stash it for the rest of the run.

tests.pmTestDesc: Define a test with a name and a callback function.
tests.pmExpectDesc: Start an assertion chain with a value.
tests.toNotEqualDesc: Assert the value is not equal.
tests.toHavePropertyDesc: Assert that an object has a specific property.
tests.toIncludeDesc: Assert that a string contains or array includes a value.
tests.toBeOneOfDesc: Assert that the value is one of the given values.
tests.pmResponseDesc: Available properties on the response object.
tests.pmEnvSetDesc: Save a value to the active environment. Survives across requests and sessions. Use this to capture tokens, IDs, etc. from a response and reuse them in later requests via {{key}}.
tests.quickExtractDesc: Use the Extract to env button above the editor to generate a pm.environment.set() snippet from any JSON path in the last response.

curl.buttonTooltip: Paste a curl command to import as a new request
curl.dialogDescription: Paste a curl command. The `curl` prefix is optional; Postman / DevTools / hand-written formats all work. Headers, query params, body, and auth are parsed into a new tab.
curl.parseError: Could not parse input as a cURL command.
curl.preserveFileRefsOne: Preserve file references — this cURL has {{count}} file field. Off (default): file rows land with empty attachments so you can pick your own copy. On: the original filename + mime hint are kept (use only if you have the same file locally).
curl.preserveFileRefsOther: Preserve file references — this cURL has {{count}} file fields. Off (default): file rows land with empty attachments so you can pick your own copy. On: the original filename + mime hint are kept (use only if you have the same file locally).
curl.previewEmpty: Paste a curl command to see what will be imported.
curl.previewInvalid: Not a recognizable curl command yet. Make sure at least one of: <c>curl …</c>, <c>-H</c>, <c>--header</c>, <c>-X</c>, <c>-d</c>, or another curl flag is present.

extract.noResponse: No response yet — send the request first.
extract.invalidJson: Response body is not valid JSON.
extract.title: Extract response field to environment
extract.description: Pick a JSON path from the last response and save it to an environment variable.

standalone.signInBody: Sign in from the main PatchMan window — this detached tab shares that session.

execTarget.title: Execution target
execTarget.localDesc: Run on this machine. Results forwarded to your remote history.
execTarget.remoteDesc: Run on the PatchMan server. Consistent with teammates.

reqSettings.timeoutHelp: How long to wait for the upstream response before giving up. Raise it for slow endpoints (e.g. a long-running job); when it fires, the in-flight request is cancelled instead of being left running. Leave it empty to use the default ({{seconds}}s). Applies to every request and is saved on this device only — it isn’t shared or synced.

save.title: Save Request
save.linkedDesc: This request is linked to a saved collection item.
save.toCollectionDesc: Save this request to an existing collection.
